arguments.name: Output
arguments.description: The output file to write the combined solution to.

arguments.name: TraverseDirectory
arguments.description: The directory to traverse for solution files. This is not  necessarily the same as the output directory.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: If toggled the output file will be overwritten if it  already exists.

description: Combine projects from multiple .sln and .slnx files into a single XML solution.
